title: Ahemfie a Wɔde Ahwehwɛ a Wɔde Ahwehwɛ ayɛ
intro: Fa w’adwene bu asase bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a ahonyade ne anuonyam wom a wɔsom owia mmom sen ne Bɔfo no. Krataa bi ba a ɛwɔ ɔfrɛ a wontumi mmu ani ngu so, na akwantu bi fi ase kɔ asɛnnibea a ɛsõ sen nea wɔahu pɛn. Ɛhɔ no, fam a ɛdaadaa aniwa bɛda adwemmɔne adi, na bere tiaa bi a emu da hɔ no bɛsakra biribiara.
clues: Medii asaase a edi yie a ne nkurofoo kotow awia sena Allah.
Me nsa kaa krataa a ɛyɛ animuonyam bi a ɛfrɛ me sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ mema me ho so na mmom memmra brɛ me ho ase mma Allah.
Mibisabisaa m’agyinatukuw no na midii kan paw aman ntam nkitahodi, na mede akyɛde bi kɔmaa me de sɔɔ nea ɔde kɔmaa no no hwɛe.
Mebaa Sulayman, na wɔde m’ankasa m’ahengua no kyerɛɛ me a wɔakata wɔn ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛsɔ sɛnea mihu me no ahwɛ.
Mehyɛn ahemfie bi a ɛkorɔn a midii mfomso sɛ ɛyɛ nsu a emu dɔ a ahwehwɛ fam a ɛyɛ torotoro no mu.
Mede me ahobrɛaseɛ ne Sulayman too gua maa Allah, wiase nyinaa Awurade.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
